verdict.rationale: PostHog's own docs clearly document session replay of real user sessions, with DVR-style playback and a synced DevTools panel, so the viewing half of the story is delivered. Nothing in the evidence addresses masking of sensitive input, by default or otherwise, so the privacy half is unproven. Missing for 10: documented default masking of sensitive inputs, privacy controls for recordings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch recordings of real user sessions with sensitive input masked by default

citations.quote: Session replay records what real users do in your product and plays it back like a DVR
Watch real user sessions of interactions with your website or mobile app to diagnose issues and understand user behavior.
